# ZMobile Storefront

> The premier online destination for mobile devices, smartwatches, and premium accessories in Pakistan.

## Navigation

- [Home](/) - The homepage with featured category rails, popular brands, and current promotional campaigns.
- [Store](/store) - Browse all mobile and electronics products. Supports filtering by brand, category, price range, and product specifications.
- [Brands](/brands) - View all trusted manufacturers and brands.
- [Blog](/blog) - Read the latest reviews, comparisons, and technology articles.
